# A week when I was not the backup

Mum's arrangements worked while I was away. She called because she wanted to talk about the choir, not because the plan had failed. [[Care arrangements]] should make my absence possible without turning other people into permanent substitutes. Ask them what the week cost before declaring the arrangement sustainable.
